phases.B_ml_rigor: DONE (2026-06-28): ml/patterns.py rewritten + ml_finder.py + indicators.partition_features/CROSS_ASSET_COMPARABLE_TYPES + batch.extract_trades Source tagging + config ML_SAMPLE_FLOOR/ML_HOLDOUT_FRAC/ML_FDR_ALPHA. (1) ML finder DEFAULTS to normalized cross-asset features (v7 set + bounded oscillators); raw/absolute features are warned and per-instrument z-scored (groupby Source) BEFORE bulk concat. (2) Time-ordered holdout (70/30, default) OR walk-forward k-fold (TimeSeriesSplit): rules mined on train, scored OOS via dt leaf->predicate re-evaluation. (3) Gate per leaf: OOS sample-size floor (30) -> one-sided binomial vs OOS baseline -> Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (alpha 0.10) -> Wilson lower-bound must still beat baseline. Survivors -> result['rules'] (OOS win-rate, wilson_lb, p/q, train vs OOS); failures -> result['candidate_rules'] with reject reason. XGBoost importance kept descriptive (full matrix, NOT gated). Helpers wilson_lower_bound/binom_sf/benjamini_hochberg exported. tests/test_ml_rigor.py (11, synthetic+portable). Legacy positional mine_patterns call + old ML tests still green (parity). Effort M.

KEEP the clone's CHANGELOG.md + LICENSE + .gitignore. Strip __pycache__/*.pyc. (The local dev tree is still under 'modular history/'; only the REMOTE is flat.)
4. Update root CHANGELOG.md (new entry) + README.md (version callout).
5. SECRET SCAN: git grep gho_/ghp_/eyJ/-----BEGIN; confirm no .env/.db/quantdesk_data.db/.master_cache/strategies/plots staged; confirm quantdesk/data/ package present (9 files); compileall.
6. git add -A; commit (end with Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8); git tag -a vX; push main + tag; gh release create vX.
7. Verify remote root has the app + no secrets; rm -rf /d/_ht_pub.
8. If asked, sync sambhav (see repos.sambhav.sync_procedure) — it mirrors the whole tree so the flat layout carries over automatically.

key_decisions: Keep backtesting.py as the engine (do NOT swap to NautilusTrader/VectorBT).

Keep Plotly for charts; do NOT pivot to Bokeh or TradingView Lightweight Charts (multi-agent debate verdict: messiness was a DESIGN bug, fixed in v6.1; st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in Streamlit 1.58; LWC is a third-party iframe with quirks). Optional native-Bokeh 'Pro chart' embed kept behind a toggle only.
Indicator placement (overlay vs own panel) is single-sourced in config.INDICATOR_PLACEMENT.
Default download save format = Both (Parquet + CSV); CSV can go to a separate folder.
Vectorised indicators are proven byte-equal to originals (test_parity.py); toggle via indicators.USE_VECTORIZED.
Local tools work without broker login; only live downloaders/options need auth.
modular.json is the granular file-by-file index, updated via .workflow/modlog.py (env MODLOG_AGENT=name; commands: file/log/feature/speed/phase/agent).
gotchas: pandas >= 3: in-place float assignment into an int64 column raises (fixed corporate_actions by casting OHLCV to float first).
ML per-trade return column is 'ReturnPct' (fraction), NOT 'Return [%]' (that's overall stats).
backtesting.py Position has NO .entry_price; use self.trades[-1].entry_price (trailing-stop codegen).
_prev_position_size is SIGNED (negative for shorts) — short trailing fresh-entry guard is '>= 0'.
st.cache_data deep-copies its return each rerun; master list uses cache_resource + session_state to avoid 53MB copies.
Headless Chrome in this sandbox cannot screenshot Plotly/canvas (kaleido fails to launch Chrome); rely on AppTest + structural tests; use a real browser for visual confirmation.
Streamlit st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in 1.58; embed Bokeh via components.html(file_html(...)).
Tests hardcode the D:\simpleton data path (not portable to CI/other machines) — a known deferred item.
Windows multiprocessing: spawn children import the worker module; run ProcessPool tests via a real .py with __main__ guard (tests/manual_batch_check.py), not heredoc.
